'''rogue_wraith Senatorial Funding Approves Fleet Expenditures''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[rogue_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 21 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif|label=My Lord, Is That Legal?}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Lord, Is That Legal?
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS5 Legal rogue wraith DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Admiral Motti (V) (Virtual Set 2), General Veers (V) (Virtual Set 4), Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V) (Virtual Set 2), Blizzard 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4), Location, Location, Location (V) (Virtual Set 5): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

Please help me find focus for this Senate/Fleet/Ground deck.

Ten shields posted under Fear Is My Ally, all named.

== Notes ==

* The draft had counted the ten shields in the deck and dropped Allegations Of Corruption and A Useless Gesture; they are now in the shields list, outside the 60. Secret Plans there is the Reflections III shield.
* Do They Have A Code Clearance? and Oppressive Enforcement (pulled by Prepared Defenses) are the Coruscant / Special Edition Effects.
* Original-era (V): Admiral Motti (V) and Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V) x5 (VS2); Reactor Terminal (V) (VS3, shield); Blizzard 1 (V) and General Veers (V) (VS4; the draft had dropped both Vs); Location, Location, Location (V) (VS5); Firepower (V) (VS6, shield).
* Posted 'Lord Maul' is the Reflections III card (the draft had Darth Maul); 'Admiral Piet' Admiral Piett; 'Chimera' Chimaera.

== Strategy ==

I don't really know what this deck does.  Surprisingly, initial play test have been pretty good.  Since it has no clear focus, except Senators arguing (usually with themselves) in the Senate (and that not very important), there's nothing to disrupt.  I've just been waiting for my opponent to reveal their game plan, then doing whatever I can to mess it up.  And with 3 lightsabers, as many a 5 battle destinies sometimes and 17 Star Destroyers, there's a lot of messing up power in this deck.

So, what do you think?  How can it be improved?
